proposed_definition_en: The region within the boundary of a physical entity
sense_alignment_note: Both proposals describe a bounded interior region; standardize the noun label
decision_reason: The spatial region sense is supported; standardize part of speech as noun; keep nonspatial uses separate

proposed_definition_en: The north side of a mountain or south side of a river in geographic usage
sense_alignment_note: The two nominations share the geographic noun sense; standardize the noun label
decision_reason: Dictionary identifies the geographic noun sense; distinguish it from shade and other senses

proposed_definition_en: The south side of a mountain or north side of a river in geographic usage
sense_alignment_note: The two nominations share the geographic noun sense; standardize the noun label
decision_reason: Dictionary identifies the geographic noun sense; distinguish it from sunlight and other senses

proposed_definition_en: To move along a route around a physical reference entity
sense_alignment_note: The term also permits static surrounding; this pilot specifies movement around a referent
decision_reason: Separate moving-around from static surrounding before comparing feature scores

proposed_definition_en: A loss of bodily stability while standing or moving
sense_alignment_note: The nomination combines noun and verb and bodily and mechanical readings; this pilot uses a bodily state noun
decision_reason: Narrow to bodily disequilibrium; verify the nominal use in an example before final selection

proposed_definition_en: The state of belonging to a group or community
sense_alignment_note: The nomination combines affiliation and felt belonging; this pilot uses group membership
decision_reason: Separate group membership from subjective sense of belonging; verify nominal use and team scope

proposed_definition_en: A line or surface marking the limit of a physical region
sense_alignment_note: Both nominations support a physical region-limit sense; nonphysical limits are excluded
decision_reason: Physical boundary noun sense is suitable for the pilot; taxonomy path remains unverified

proposed_definition_en: At a higher position than a physical reference entity along a vertical axis
sense_alignment_note: The nomination specifies a physical higher-than relation, not quantity or text order
decision_reason: Spatial preposition sense is clear; require a physical referent in the example

proposed_definition_en: A route connecting positions through physical space
sense_alignment_note: Both noun nominations describe a spatial route, not a figurative career or plan
decision_reason: The physical route sense is clear; later category work needs a sense-specific parent

proposed_definition_en: A state in which two physical surfaces touch
sense_alignment_note: Both noun nominations describe surface touching, not communication
decision_reason: Physical touching is a distinct spatial-contact sense

proposed_definition_en: The ability to remain upright without falling
sense_alignment_note: The nomination combines bodily and mechanical stability; this pilot uses bodily balance
decision_reason: Specify bodily balance so proprioceptive scoring is not inferred from a mechanical sense

proposed_definition_en: A feeling of being accepted as part of a group
sense_alignment_note: The nomination mixes recognized membership and felt inclusion; this pilot uses the felt social sense
decision_reason: Use one felt-membership sense so social and internal-feeling judgments refer to the same target
